message: Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/PcapPlusPlus && grep -n "someipsdhdr\|someiphdr" Packet++/header/SomeIpLayer.h Packet++/header/SomeIpSdLayer.h | head -30` executed with exit code 0.

message.content:
Now I understand the vulnerability. The `countOptions()` function reads `getLenEntries()` which reads a 4-byte value at `m_Data + sizeof(someipsdhdr)`. If the data is too short (i.e., `dataLen < sizeof(someipsdhdr) + sizeof(uint32_t)`), this read goes out of bounds.

The description says "Heap-buffer-overflow READ 2" - this means reading 2 bytes beyond the buffer. Let me check the `someipsdhdr` structure size and understand the exact scenario.

Let me look at the header definitions:
